Before attempting to install or remove the Turning Gear, the Hydraulic Brake must be applied to prevent the generator from rotating.

Once the Turning Gear motors are engaged, ensure that the Hydraulic Brake is released before attempting to rotate the Drivetrain with the Turning Gear Pendant.

Consult document 0053-7811 for the specific installation and removal procedures.
